summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Veritech.AI admin dashboard. 32/32 pytest tests passed (23 new admin tests + 9 legacy public API). Frontend admin login → dashboard → tabs → CSV/Excel exports → logout → protected route redirect all work as expected. Public landing visit tracking confirmed.

minor.issue: conversion_rate_percent can exceed 100% (observed 225%) because formula is contacts_count / unique_sessions and unique_sessions counts only visits that called /track/visit; existing seeded contacts inflate ratio. Consider clamping to 100 or rephrasing the metric.

Brute-force lockout key uses request.client.host which may rotate behind multi-pod ingress (no X-Forwarded-For handling). Lockout still triggers in practice within the same pod, but is not fully reliable. Consider trusting X-Forwarded-For.

issues: Recharts logs 4 console warnings on first mount: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Likely because ResponsiveContainer parent has no explicit height before content lays out. Charts do render on settle; minor cosmetic console noise.
Conversion rate can show >100% (e.g. 225%) which is misleading UX. Source is backend value; either clamp on backend or display 'N/A' when contacts > unique_visitors.

action_items: (Optional) Clamp or rephrase conversion_rate_percent so it never exceeds 100%.
(Optional) Set a default explicit height on Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents to silence width/height(-1) warnings on first paint.
(Optional, hardening) For brute-force lockout, trust X-Forwarded-For so attempts from same real IP aggregate across ingress pods.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login flow correctly hashes with bcrypt ($2b$), uses HS256 JWT with 7-day TTL, and clears login_attempts on success.
Admin seed at startup is idempotent: inserts if missing, updates password_hash only if current password fails verify; verified by restarting backend (no duplicate admin).
All admin endpoints depend on get_current_admin and correctly return 401 without/with invalid token; password_hash is excluded from the user lookup projection.
Mongo _id is consistently excluded across all admin/list endpoints (verified in test_inquiries/test_newsletter).
Tracking heartbeat uses upsert=False so a stale session_id silently no-ops; consider returning a clear non-200 instead of {ok:true, matched:0} for observability.

CORS is set with allow_credentials=True and allow_origins=['*'] (split from CORS_ORIGINS='*'). This combination is actually rejected by browsers per CORS spec; not a problem now (Bearer header, no cookies) but should be explicit origins if cookies are added later.
Frontend ProtectedRoute correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /admindata (verified by direct URL access in browser).
localStorage key 'veritech_admin_token' is cleared on logout (verified: getItem returns null).
Excel/CSV exports stream proper headers (Content-Disposition attachment with filename, correct MIME). xlsx starts with PK zip magic - verified.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert TEST_-prefixed contacts/newsletter rows and unique TEST_ session_ids; no production data modified. Lockout test uses random locktest_<hex>@example.com so admin never gets locked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 32 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/ (test_api.py = public, test_admin.py = admin/auth/tracking). All pass against public URL https://innovation-suite-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend playwright covered: login (wrong + right), 3 tabs, CSV download, logout, protected redirect, landing visit tracking. Recharts 'width(-1)' warnings are cosmetic; charts do render. Conversion rate >100% is by formula design - flag for product decision.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking issues. Two minor backend semantic notes (conversion_rate ceiling + IP-based lockout reliability) and one cosmetic frontend warning (Recharts initial mount). Everything else functions per spec.
